description: MCP server for the Google Chat API — list and search spaces, read and send messages, work with threads, reactions, attachments and memberships. For Claude, Cursor, Codex and other AI clients.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token, exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.

tool_signatures.name: send_message
tool_signatures.description: Sends a text message to a space AS THE AUTHENTICATED USER (their name and avatar; needs the chat.messages.create or chat.messages scope, and the user must be a member of the space). Text supports Chat

space.description: The space — "spaces/<id>" or the bare id from list_spaces / a Chat URL (chat.google.com/room/<id>).

message_id.description: Custom id for the message, e.g. "client-deploy-42"; must be unique per space.

thread_key.description: Opaque key of your choosing: first use starts a thread, reuse replies into it.

thread_name.description: Reply into this existing thread (thread.name from get_message/list_messages).

reply_option.description: When targeting a thread: fallback_to_new_thread (default) starts a new thread if it doesn't exist; or_fail errors instead.
